source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references: PostgreSQL 18 query path and EXPLAIN documentation, the Selinger System R paper, Volcano and Cascades papers, Graefe's query-evaluation survey, current Apache Calcite algebra documentation, Substrait specification, SQLite EQP documentation, and current DuckDB EXPLAIN documentation. All final destinations were retrieved. Historical mechanisms and current product claims are separately scoped.

evidence: Checked syntax/analyzed tree, logical/physical operator, property, enforcer, alternative, memo, cardinality/selectivity, startup/total cost, residual recheck, pipeline breaker, and Bag(P,D) terms.
Checked operator schemas, multiplicity, nullability, expression volatility/errors, correlation, and explicit order remain distinct annotations.
Checked required-versus-delivered property direction and startup-versus-total cost terminology.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Plan trees, DAGs/memos, runtime state, and explain artifacts are not conflated.

evidence: Recomputed direct join/filter/project/order result as Ada/101 and Babbage/103.
Independently reproduced the same ordered bag using hash lookup and indexed grouped traversal.
Confirmed order 102 is removed by amount filter and unmatched order 104 is removed by inner join.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Finite counts and values establish only the chapter dataset, not general SQL equivalence.

evidence: Reviewed rewrite obligation Bag(L,D)=Bag(L',D) under stated bag/null/collation/effect/error/order preconditions.
Reviewed compositional physical proof: children meet requirements, operator implements logical semantics, delivered properties satisfy the parent, and the root satisfies external observables.
Verified cost ranking occurs only after semantic/property feasibility and cannot justify an invalid rewrite.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Universal rewrite proofs are obligations described by the chapter; the executable is deliberately finite evidence.

evidence: Reviewed empty, duplicate, null, unmatched, many-to-many, collation, boundary numeric, volatile/erroring expression, and incidental-versus-required order cases.

Reviewed inner/outer/semi/anti/lateral/correlated joins, CTE/subplan/materialization, window/limit/ordered aggregates, residual recheck, parameterized loops, parallel exchange, and adaptive boundaries.

Reviewed DML target identity, locking/version recheck, triggers/constraints/RETURNING, EXPLAIN versus EXPLAIN ANALYZE, sequences/external effects, cache/statistics/parameter changes, and plan pin expiry.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Engine-specific unsupported features must reject or safely fall back rather than silently lower to an invalid plan.

evidence: Checked binding preserves names/types/collations/privileges/parameters and rewrites preserve multiplicity/null/order/effects/errors.
Checked every physical alternative has input requirements, delivered properties, schema/lifecycle, residual conditions, and visibility/locking obligations.
Checked missing order/distribution/rewindability is supplied by an explicit enforcer and estimates never authorize semantic illegality.
invariant_checking.notes: Plan correctness includes relational results, physical properties, and DML/transaction effects.

evidence: Reviewed contextual equivalence preconditions for bags, null-rejecting outer-join filters, NOT IN/NOT EXISTS, correlation, volatility, and order.
Reviewed property composition for hash plus sort, ordered index nested loop, and merge join with ordered inputs.
Reviewed memo/rule search, feasibility, pruning, enforcers, cost/cardinality separation, and transfer from runtime evidence.
proof_review.notes: The chapter does not claim one framework or representation is mandatory for every engine.

evidence: The finite executable explicitly disclaims SQL nulls, duplicates, collation, MVCC, cost, spill, and optimizer coverage.
Historical System R/Volcano/Cascades claims are separated from current PostgreSQL/Calcite/Substrait/SQLite/DuckDB behavior.
Estimated cost/cardinality, measured execution, semantic proof, plan-shape regression, and operational hypothesis are labeled separately.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No example result or observed plan shape is presented as a universal optimizer proof.

evidence: Repository verification passed one standard-library Python snippet with exact nine-line stdout, empty stderr, zero exit status, and recorded toolchain.
Independent recomputation recorded the expected bag/order, unmatched and filtered IDs, and hash/index equivalence in artifacts/reviews/DBE-051/independent-recomputation.txt.
All ten source destinations were retained and all repository-local links resolved.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No live database EXPLAIN/ANALYZE, SQL optimizer, statistics/cardinality model, spill, parallel/distributed execution, DML, concurrency, benchmark, or production regression was executed.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed the representation pipeline, logical semantics, contextual equivalence, physical contracts/properties, enforcers, memo/rule search, cost/cardinality, tree/DAG/parameterization, DML, explain evidence, regressions, and adversarial verification as one coherent graduate-level foundation.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed structured/raw plan capture, environment binding, estimate-versus-actual diagnosis, loops/buffers/spill/workers/waits, safe EXPLAIN ANALYZE use, statistics/index/configuration remedies, scoped plan pinning, privacy, and correctness/performance release gates.

pedagogical_review.notes: The chapter begins at representation boundaries, derives semantic/property proof obligations, uses three concrete physical realizations, supplies twelve misconceptions, ten distinct worked examples, and five progressive exercises with complete model answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary-source, mathematical, executable-snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic, PostgreSQL/Calcite/Substrait/SQLite/DuckDB or optimizer/executor maintainer, standards, security, performance, reliability, operations, or independent practitioner review is claimed. The chapter and finite example prove neither universal SQL rewrite equivalence, correct handling of all bags/nulls/collations/effects/errors, correctness of a named optimizer or executor, cost/cardinality accuracy, spill/parallel/distributed/DML/concurrency behavior, stable plan interchange, workload-independent performance, certification, nor deployment fitness.
